candidates.label: Ganaxolone

candidates.label: Sodium channel blocking anti-seizure medicines (class)
candidates.summary: A class of established anti-seizure medicines that reduce sodium channel activity. Published responses differ by gene and by variant mechanism.

mentions.sentence: CLN3 disease is a neuronopathic lysosomal storage disorder that severely impacts the central nervous system (CNS) while also inducing notable peripheral neuromuscular symptoms.

mentions.sentence: Similar myopathic alterations were present in a muscle biopsy from an 8-year-old human CLN3 patient shortly after diagnosis.

To assess a potential therapeutic intervention, we administered intravenous gene therapy using AAV9.hCLN3 to neonatal Cln3Δex7/8 mice, which at disease endstage, entirely prevented tSC loss and NMJ abnormalities, while also averting skeletal muscle atrophy.
